issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: The problem statement (UML and textual description) and the template usage expect a no-argument method Rideable.messageOnRide() that returns a String (e.g. "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"). The solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) and Pig/Seal implementations also require an int parameter and include speed in the returned string. This discrepancy between the specified API (no parameters) and the solution implementation (one int parameter) will confuse students and prevents the solution from matching the API shown in the problem and used in the template Main.java.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution API to match the problem statement and template by declaring Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters (String messageOnRide()) and update Pig and Seal to implement this no-arg method, returning "Riding on [AnimalType] [name]". Alternatively, if the speed parameter is intentional, update the problem statement, UML, and template Main.java to specify and use messageOnRide(int speed) throughout.
